usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.admin.organization.projects.service_accounts.list("project_id", limit: 20, after: "after")
pp result

fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 20.

fields.name: after
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `organization.project.service_account`

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the service account

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the service account was created
